title: Exam FRQ: the recipe scaler
prompt:
45-minute FRQ section. Implement the `Recipe` class:

- constructor takes the base servings (int) and base sugar (int grams)
- `scaleTo(int servings)` returns the sugar needed for the requested servings: baseSugar * servings / baseServings (integer division)
- `addServings(int extra)` increases the REMAINING planned servings (starts equal to baseServings; never below 0)
- `remaining()` reports planned servings
- `serve(int n)` reduces remaining by n, floored at 0, and returns true if there were enough servings planned, else false (changing nothing when false)

Implement the class.

tests.name: recipe scaler frq
tests.hint: scaleTo is proportion math with integer division; serve guards on n <= remaining before mutating.
